confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 18 Nov 2026 found via search. Food and drink anchors are based on one cost-of-living search covering aggregated sources (citycost.org, Squareyards, Numbeo-derived guides). Those sources vary widely. I did not search for wine by the glass or cocktails. I estimated them from the local beer price: a restaurant wine glass at about 2.5 times a beer, and a cocktail at about 3 times a beer, since alcohol is taxed heavily and licensed venues mark it up. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Indian tourist cities such as Udaipur, Agra and Jodhpur, which have similar budget-to-heritage hotel markets.
